  • Reference

    The catalogue of ornaments

    dk_ornaments.Rd

    A table of every ornament kind in the package: its id, a readable label, its family, the box shape it looks best in, and whether a seed varies it. Use dk_ornament() to build one by id.

    dk_ornaments()

    Value

    A data frame with columns id, label, family ("rule", "border", "medallion", "corner" or "mark"), ratio (suggested box width / height), and seeded.

    Examples

    dk_ornaments()
#>              id             label    family ratio seeded
#> 1  swelled_rule      Swelled rule      rule     8   TRUE
#> 2  fleuron_rule      Fleuron rule      rule     8   TRUE
#> 3         swash         Pen swash      rule     6   TRUE
#> 4       rinceau           Rinceau    border     8   TRUE
#> 5     greek_key         Greek key    border    10   TRUE
#> 6       scallop    Scallop border    border    10   TRUE
#> 7  compass_rose      Compass rose medallion     1  FALSE
#> 8     guilloche         Guilloche medallion     1   TRUE
#> 9       rosette     Petal rosette medallion     1   TRUE
#> 10     sunburst          Sunburst medallion     1   TRUE
#> 11       corner   Corner flourish    corner     1   TRUE
#> 12     asterism Dinkus / asterism      mark     3   TRUE
